name: Oath-Mark
summary: As a bonus action, mark one creature you can see within 90 ft as the subject of your oath. Until the end of your next turn, your first weapon hit against that creature deals bonus damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Uses: proficiency bonus per long rest.
